## Build

The top-level build script is `CMakeLists.txt` at the repository root (`cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)`, `project(qtintegration)`).

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
sudo cmake --install build
```

## Dependencies

`Build-Depends` in `debian/control` lists 24 entries; the first 8 are listed below (see `debian/control` for the complete list):

- `debhelper-compat (= 12)`
- `cmake`
- `pkg-config`
- `libfontconfig1-dev`
- `libfreetype-dev`
- `libglib2.0-dev`
- `libmtdev-dev`
- `libegl1-mesa-dev`

The top-level `CMakeLists.txt` looks up 5 packages with `find_package`: `QT`, `Qt6`, `DtkBuildHelper`, `Dtk`, `Qt`.
